what: When the photo cell enters the screen, a background-color cover over it lifts upward over 1.5s (height 100% → 0), and the photo rises from 100px below with a .2s delay over 1.5s (easeOutCubic). Leaving the screen rewinds it so it repeats each time it re-enters (with once it plays a single time).

options.rise: Distance the photo rises (px), default 100 — 0 means cover only
options.once: If true, only once (the original repeats every time it leaves and re-enters)
options.veil-delay: Delay before the cover starts to lift (sec), default 0
options.ease: Cover/photo curve — four numbers like “0.19,1,0.22,1” or a css curve, default cubic-bezier(.215,.61,.355,1)

from.where: shared.css .eu-ph — photo reveal for the concept band, popular styles, shop and careers style photos

index.html .cs-vol__banner·.cs-card__pic (over the regional pattern·product photo, a cover in that issue’s color folds up .2s late over 1.2s cubic-bezier(.19,1,.22,1) — Studio reveal effect height 100%→0, the photo does not rise, the inner zoom-fade-in runs 1.1x→1 over 3s)
from.options: rise: 0; dur: 1.2; veil-delay: .2; ease: 0.19,1,0.22,1; once: true
